oids.description: A unique value for the table. Its value ranges between 1 and 65535 and may not be contigous. the index has no other meaning but a pure index

oids.name: snsRouteRouterName
oids.description: Name of the router object in which the gateway belongs to

oids.description: IPv4 or IPv6 of the gateway

oids.description: Date of the last reachability check of the gateway (%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S)

oids.name: snsRouteStateLastChange
oids.description: Date since the gateway is in this reachability state (%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S)

oids.name: snsRouteActive
oids.description: Indicates if the gateway is currently used for the routing

oids.name: snsRouteActiveLastChange
oids.description: Date since the gateway is active or not (%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S)

oids.name: snsRouteSysDefaultGateway
oids.description: Indicates if the gateway is currently used as the system default route

oids.name: snsRouteSysDefaultGatewayLastChange
oids.description: Date since the gateway is used or not as the system default route (%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S)

oids.name: snsRouteUsagePrct
oids.description: Usage percentage of this gateway among all the gateways member of this router

oids.name: snsRouteMonitoringMethod
oids.description: Monitoring method used to retrieve gateway's metrics (ICMP|TCP_PROBE)

oids.name: snsRouteLatency
oids.description: Gateway latency expressed in ms. A value of zero means that the monitored host could not be reached.

oids.name: snsRouteJitter
oids.description: Gateway jitter expressed in ms. If the latency is zero, the jitter metric is not valid.

oids.name: snsRoutePacketLossPrct
oids.description: Percentage of packet loss for one message. A negative value means that this route is not monitored or has not yet been monitored.

oids.name: snsRouteUnreachPrct
oids.description: Percentage of time in a period when gateway was unreachable. A negative value means that this route is not monitored or has not yet been monitored.
